title: Smackball
description:
Smackball is a fast-paced, competitive sports game for two players, inspired by sports like tennis, squash and air-hockey. The rules are simple: smack the ball across half court before your timer runs out, and try to score a goal against your opponent!Features:• Play locally, against your friends or the AI.

• Play online, in private matches against your friends, or match up against random players.

• 5 different game modes.

• 8 color palettes to personalize the look of the game.

• Customize the gameplay and create your own game modes.
Note:You’ll need at least one controller for local multiplayer matches.
description_short: Smackball is what you get when you fuse tennis, squash and air-hockey into a competitive video game. Play in fast-paced 1v1 matches against your friends, the AI, or anyone. Smack your way to victory!
